classification_rules: Food Not Bombs chapter relations model autonomous movement membership and do not imply command hierarchy.
Current official profile links may establish public account ownership; similarity of names alone may not merge organizations.
The pre-existing generic Cleveland FNB record is not collapsed into East/Lake County or West until direct identity evidence resolves the collision.
No private individual membership is inferred from organization pages, events, or service participation.
data.method: Re-verify the prior Cleveland unresolved queue against current public sources, split only separately named locals, capture first-party public profile endpoints, and preserve unresolved identity collisions.
data.research_question: Which current Cleveland-area Food Not Bombs locals and public account endpoints can be safely materialized from the prior unresolved queue?

findings.finding: Current official Food Not Bombs CLE Linktree resolves Instagram @foodnotbombs_cle, TikTok @fnbeastcle, and Facebook fnblc.
Current public Cleveland resource material separately names CLE East and CLE West Food Not Bombs locals.
The Lake County/Willoughby and Cleveland East service footprint remains current in a January 2026 statewide food-resource directory using the same public contact number.
The exact identity relationship among the pre-existing generic Cleveland FNB record, Lake County/Cleveland East, and Cleveland West remains unresolved and is intentionally not collapsed.
